title: PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the LAFD CAL-JAC Revolving Training Fund 40K Fiscal Year 2025-26 Annual Report.
text:
[Council File 26-1159]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the LAFD CAL-JAC Revolving Training Fund 40K Fiscal Year 2025-26 Annual Report.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Board of Fire Commissioners report dated August 19, 2026, relative to the LAFD CAL-JAC Revolving Training Fund 40K Fiscal Year 2025-26 Annual Report.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Fire Commissioners reports that the fiscal impact of the CAL-JAC reimbursement program directly affects the LAFD budget. Monies in the fund are expended toward the training of Department Paramedic and Firefighter personnel and provide necessary support services and instructional supplies that are not otherwise covered by the General Fund.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted (Nov 6, 2026); Council action final
